payload.reason: The evidence provides detailed methods for building gazetteer resources from the Wikidata knowledge base, including processing entity types and filtering based on popularity.

claims.text: Gazetteer resources are built from Wikidata by processing official dumps into tuples of entity and type based on the 'instance_of' triplet.
Entities are filtered by sitelink count to retain the most popular types, reducing ambiguity in the gazetteer data.
Wikidata is preferred over Wikipedia for gazetteer building due to its larger and more structured dataset.
The types in the gazetteer can be adjusted from fine-grained to coarse-grained based on the NER task requirements using the subclass_of property.
